author: Smosko
title: Paid EP Cover Artwork Opportunity
content: Hello! Paid project opportunity for visual artists 👇 I’m looking for a visual artist to create the cover artwork for my very first EP. Looking for: digital illustration inspired by Magritte’s surrealist and dreamlike aesthetic. (A detailed brief will be shared with shortlisted artists.) If you’re interested, feel free to reach out via Instagram DM or email(itssmosko@gmail.com) and share your portfolio so I can have a look at your work. Looking forward to discovering your creative worlds! Smosko

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Commission Pokémon Scenes for Custom Card Binders
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 Contact via DM or reply with portfolio, pricing, and availability.

author: Cassidy Cole
title: Looking for Character Artists for Books
content: Looking for character artists who have openings to do some character art for a few of my published and upcoming books!! (Absolutely no AI) Contact via DM or reply with portfolio.

author: Meg Humble
title: Seeking Character Artists for 2 Full Body Pieces
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰 Reply in comments with portfolio/examples. No DMs.
